movie.title: Dog 51
movie.overview: In the near future, Paris is divided into three zones that separate social classes, and no one can escape ALMA, a predictive AI that has revolutionized law enforcement. When ALMA’s creator is assassinated, Salia, a top agent, and Zem, a jaded cop, are forced to work together to solve a murder that may expose the dark secrets of the system they serve.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In a segregated near-future Paris governed by a predictive AI, an elite agent and a world-weary cop must team up to solve the assassination of the system's creator.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Near-future Paris is rigidly divided into social zones and closely monitored by ALMA, an advanced predictive AI that dictates law enforcement. When the brilliant creator behind ALMA is mysteriously assassinated, two unlikely allies are forced to work together on the investigation: Salia, an elite top-tier agent, and Zem, a disillusioned, jaded detective. As they delve deeper into the high-stakes murder case, they begin to uncover unsettling truths about the society they protect. Their search for justice threatens to expose dark, dangerous secrets buried at the very heart of the system.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In a dystopian near-future, the city of Paris has been restructured into three distinct zones that rigidly segregate its population by social class. Overseeing this delicate social order is ALMA, a revolutionary predictive artificial intelligence that has transformed law enforcement by neutralizing threats before they can fully materialize. The status quo is shattered when the mastermind and creator behind ALMA is brutally assassinated in a seemingly impossible breach of security. To investigate the high-profile crime, authorities pair Salia, a precise and devoted elite agent, with Zem, a cynical cop who has grown disillusioned with the regime. Initially clashing over their contrasting philosophies and methods, the duo must learn to navigate the stark divisions between the city's wealthy upper crust and its marginalized lower sectors. As their joint investigation progresses, they discover evidence suggesting the killer knew internal vulnerabilities that only an insider could exploit. The trail leads them through a web of corporate deception, underground resistance groups, and high-level political corruption. Ultimately, Salia and Zem realize that solving the murder means confronting a truth that could dismantle the entire predictive system and expose the dark compromises upon which their society was built.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the backdrop of a futuristic Paris partitioned into strict socio-economic zones, 'Dog 51' explores a society maintained under the watchful eye of ALMA, an authoritative predictive AI designed to revolutionize crime prevention and social control. When the visionary engineer responsible for creating ALMA is murdered, the state assigns elite operative Salia and hardened detective Zem to lead the joint investigation. As they move across the starkly divided city districts, the pair must bridge their ideological differences to untangle a complex conspiracy that spans corporate boardrooms, technological surveillance, and street-level resistance. 'Dog 51' delivers a suspenseful science fiction thriller that examines artificial intelligence, socio-economic disparity, and the ethical costs of absolute security.

story_structure.resolution: The agents must face the fallout of their discoveries, permanently altering their understanding of the city's social order and their place within the system.
story_structure.introduction: In a near-future Paris rigidly partitioned into three social zones, top agent Salia and jaded cop Zem operate under the pervasive, predictive oversight of the ALMA AI law enforcement system.
story_structure.risingAction: As Salia and Zem navigate the city's divided sectors to pursue clues, escalating threats and hidden motives reveal that the crime is linked to corrupt secrets embedded at the core of the system.
